question: When a fake observe worker is deliberately held beyond the caller future 8-second timeout, does the pending Future remain live, finish exactly once after release, write a complete exact-call report, and drain before interface_close/TemporaryDirectory teardown without dispatch or cleanup race?
pass_rule: Both frozen attempts pass all lifecycle assertions and exit 0; any timeout, extra invocation, stale temp, cleanup exception, or nonzero exit fails. This proves only the deterministic local callback-drain path.
invariants: caller receives a timeout at 8 seconds while the worker remains in-flight;
the same future completes after an explicit release within 30 seconds;
exact call report is finalized and has no temporary file;
all worker-side work completes before close and tempdir teardown;
the same assertions pass in normal and optimized mode.
